disposition_reason: Primary cross-sectional study of 25 multifloral honeys from four regions of Ardabil province, Iran, reporting As, Cd, Cr, Pb, Ni (plus Zn, Cu) as mean, min, max and SD in µg/kg by region and for all samples.

study.design: cross-sectional beekeeper sampling across four regions
study.material_scope: Multifloral honey made by traditional procedures, supplied by local beekeepers' association / individual beekeepers with guaranteed origin
study.growing_origin_vs_market: Growing origin: Ardabil province, NW Iran — East (Ardabil County, n=6), North (Moghan County, n=7), South (Khalkhal County, n=6), West (Meshkinshar County, n=6). Not purchased at retail.
study.sampling_unit: honey samples (400 g each, glass jars)
study.method: 1 g honey in PTFE vessel with 10 mL conc. HNO3 (abstract also cites H2O2), closed-vessel microwave digestion (MARS 5; 15 min/600 W/120 °C, 20 min/600 W/180 °C); ICP-OES (text: Spectro Arcos OES EOP) with internal standards Sc, Y, Tb
study.lod_loq: Not reported explicitly; As censored at '<11.87 µg/kg' in Table 3.
study.basis: µg/kg honey; basis (fresh/as-received) not stated explicitly
study.qa: Table 2 'Heavy metals concentration and recoveries in spike honey samples' (columns labelled certified vs measured value, µg/g): As 95%, Cd 100%, Cu 99%, Pb 97.2%, Zn 88.4%, Cr 99%, Ni 96%. Text says recoveries 95–100%. Internal standards; blanks with nitric acid.

controls.control: Apiary location relative to industrial/urban areas
controls.comparator: East region (Ardabil County; described as most populated, urbanized and industrialized) vs North, South and West
controls.outcome: Pb mean 935.48 µg/kg (East) vs 324.75 (North), 205.4 (South), 595.16 (West); regional Pb difference significant (ANOVA P = 0.002). Cd highest in East (53.64) but not significant (P = 0.107); Ni and Cr not significant. Industrial attribution is the authors' interpretation, not a controlled test.
controls.locator: Methods p. 2; Results p. 4; Table 3 p. 5; Abstract

controls.control: Avoid honey contact with stainless steel surfaces and galvanized containers; use proper storage containers
controls.outcome: Recommended because honey's corrosivity can leach Cr (stainless steel) and Zn (galvanized); not tested here.
controls.locator: Conclusion p. 6; Discussion p. 6 (galvanized containers and Zn, citing ref. 55)

controls.control: Limit hazardous fertilizers / arsenic-based pesticides; monitor agricultural soils and irrigation water; consider distance of agricultural land and flower gardens from industries

contradictions_with_stored_summary: Summary table omits the SD row printed in Table 3 (e.g., all-sample Pb SD 402.14, Cd SD 32).

Summary says recoveries were for 'spiked honey'; Table 2 columns are labelled 'Certified value' / 'Measured value' while the caption says 'spike honey samples' — the primary is ambiguous, the summary presents it as settled.
Summary says As is 'censored below 11.87 ug/kg' as a method threshold; the primary never names 11.87 as an LOD or LOQ.
Summary does not mention that the Discussion (p. 6) claims significant regional differences 'for all heavy metals excepting arsenic', contradicting the Results (only Pb significant).
Summary metals list uses 'tAs' — consistent with primary (total As by ICP-OES); no conflict on values. All tabulated values in the summary match Table 3.
unresolved: Instrument inconsistency: text names a Spectro Arcos ICP-OES, while Table 1 lists 'Agilent 7500ce with ORS' (an ICP-MS model) and ICP-MS-type settings (H2/He reaction gas).
Digestion reagents: abstract says nitric acid and hydrogen peroxide; procedure describes 10 mL HNO3 only.

Discussion (p. 6) states significant regional differences for all metals except As, contradicting Results (Pb P = 0.002 significant; Cd, Zn, Ni, Cr, Cu not significant). Extraction follows the Results section.
Recovery range: text says 95–100%, Table 2 shows Zn 88.4%.
No LOD/LOQ for Cd, Cr, Pb, Ni; '<11.87' for As is not labelled.
Table 3 caption says 'different types of honey' but all samples are described as multifloral.
Zn and Cu also reported (Table 3) but outside the HMI analyte list; not extracted as findings.
Per-sample values are not printed (only region summary statistics).
